privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Neuer Barber (Kento Osada, "we") handles the personal information you give us when booking as follows.

sections.title: Business name and address
body: This site is operated by Kento Osada (sole proprietor).

rows.v: 3F South (B), Kanamura Bldg., 2-4-48 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka

sections.title: Information we collect
items: Your name (and furigana on the Japanese site)
IP address and browser information at the time of booking (to record consent and prevent abuse)

sections.title: How we use it
items: Managing your booking and contacting you about it
Statistics to improve our service (not personally identifiable)
after: If you are under 16, please book with a parent's or guardian's consent.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
body: We do not share your information with third parties except where required by law.

sections.title: Service providers
body: We use services that process data on our behalf, such as bot detection (Cloudflare Turnstile), error monitoring (Sentry) and notification delivery (Apple, Google).

sections.title: Security measures (use of overseas cloud providers)
body: We encrypt connections, restrict access to the owner signing in with a passkey, keep personal information out of logs, and encrypt backups.
sections.aside: This site uses the US cloud providers Vercel Inc. and Neon Inc., and its servers are in the United States. Under contract, these providers do not handle your personal data. We take the measures above with an understanding of the US data protection framework.

sections.title: Retention
body: Three years after your last visit (or, if you have not visited, your last booking date or the date your details were first recorded), we make your information no longer identifiable.

sections.title: Access, correction, suspension and deletion
body: After confirming your identity with your phone number, we respond without delay (within about 7 days). There is no fee. Please send requests via Instagram DM.

sections.title: Complaints
body: Please contact us via Instagram DM (@{handle}).

sections.title: Cookies
body: We use a cookie to remember your language choice and anonymous analytics that do not identify you (Vercel Web Analytics).

sections.title: Changes
body: When we change this policy, we show the date and version on this page. Your consent is recorded against the version in force when you book.

policy.title: Cancellation Policy
policy.intro: How to cancel or change a booking, and a few requests for your visit. You agree to this policy when you confirm a booking.

sections.title: Cancelling or changing
items: Please cancel or change your booking from the link on the confirmation screen (or in the calendar event) up to {hours} hours before your booking time.
To change the date or time, cancel and then book again.
After the deadline, please message us on Instagram (@{handle}).

sections.title: Arriving late
items: If you are more than 15 minutes late without letting us know, we may need to shorten or change the service.
After 30 minutes, the booking may be treated as cancelled.

sections.title: Repeated same-day cancellations or no-shows
body: We may ask you to book future visits via Instagram DM only.
sections.aside: If you are unwell or something unavoidable comes up, please just let us know.

sections.title: About bookings
body: A booking on this site is confirmed as soon as you press the confirm button (no approval step). No confirmation email is sent, so please save the confirmation screen. There is no cancellation fee.
